newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chrysler sets up regional HQ in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler sets up regional HQ in Singapore.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said on Monday it has opened its southeast Asian regional headquarters, Chrysler Southeast Asia Pte Ltd, in Singapore.
The office would implement business strategy in 15 southeast Asian markets, including Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines and Singapore, the company said in a statement.
The unit would report to Chrysler Asia-Pacific Operations, based in the company's world-wide headquarters at Auburn Hills, Michigan, United States.

Chrysler has invested over US$200 million in right hand drive product development programmes targeted for Asian markets and sales volume in southeast Asia accounts for some US$250 million, up 30 percent since 1994.
It sells more than 10,000 vehicles in southeast Asia ecah year, 6,000 of which are domestically assembled in Thailand, Malaysia and Indonesia.
Chrysler is also setting up a dealership in Singapore, Chrysler Jeep Automotive of Singapore Pte Ltd, through which a wide range of vehicles would be sold and serviced in Singapore.
Its local business partner is Komoco Auto Pte Ltd, a unit of Singapore-listed HPL Group.
